With the use of boosted PIs and efavirenz, their longer half-
lives may permit more lapses in adherence because drug levels 
stay high in the body for many days (Bangsberg, 2006; Raffa, 
2008). However, these drugs are more likely to contribute to 
drug resistance if discontinued because of rapid viral muta-
tion. Continued encouragement is needed to help patients 
adhere as closely as possible to the prescribed doses for all ART 
regimens.
